human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Before frontend code, document the Console as a separate application under apps/console that consumes read-only APIs. It must not import Python core internals, parse evidence files, compute governance signals, or become a new source of truth. Dependency: 8021.add-overview-problems-api.
human_pressure.why_now: Current architecture explicitly forbids UI state inside src/ailuros; console implementation must preserve that boundary.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.

machine_core.goal: Create a minimal console architecture document and information architecture for Overview, Runs, Run Detail, and Problems.
invariants: Depends on: 8021.add-overview-problems-api. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
contracts: Overview/Runs/Problems screens correspond to read API capabilities.
failure_semantics: Missing API data displays unknown/unavailable, not green success.

steps.title: Define screens
details: Run detail sections: Outcome, Timeline, Governance, Validation, Changes, Runtime, Evidence.

steps.title: Define MVP technical choice
details: Static HTML/CSS/JS served separately or by simple dev hosting.
No Node framework required unless repository evidence later proves need.

acceptance: Console is separate from core package.
Four screens and their API dependencies are documented.
No frontend framework is mandated for MVP.

reject_if: UI code is proposed under src/ailuros core.
Console parses .everrun/history or raw evidence to infer statuses.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
